system_description.narrative_title: Iran-related conflict drives oil-market volatility and security responses
system_description.narrative_summary: Escalating Iran-related military incidents and alleged Iran-linked terrorism are reverberating through global energy markets, producing mixed supply signals, shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, and sharp oil-price volatility. Western military deployments, reserve releases, and OPEC+ hesitation form feedbacks with crude flows and market expectations, while prosecutions and arrests in Europe reflect a parallel security/legitimacy front.
system_description.scope: Interactions among Iran-related military actions and allegations, maritime shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, Middle Eastern crude export flows, global oil market responses (prices, inventories, OPEC+ decisions), and Western military and legal actions.
adjacent_subsystems: Global crude and refined fuel markets
Maritime shipping and chokepoint security (Strait of Hormuz, rerouting)
Western domestic security and counterterrorism/legal systems
evidence_headlines: U.S. to send third carrier group to Mideast as Trump warns of new Iran strikes
Three oil tankers hit by projectiles in Hormuz strait on Tuesday, Marisks says
Middle Eastern oil exports rise to highest level since Iran war began
Oil prices fall over 3% on report of potential diesel, crude stock release; Brent back below $100
EXCLUSIVE: OPEC+ delays oil capacity review after Iran war disrupts expansion plans, sources say
Two Iranians charged in UK over alleged terrorism plot targeting Jewish community

variables.name: Military incident intensity
variables.description: Measures the frequency and severity of concentrated military incidents and hostile actions in the region affecting security conditions.

variables.name: Shipping throughput
variables.description: Measures the volume of commercial maritime tonnage transiting the strategic chokepoint(s) per unit time.

variables.name: Crude export flow
variables.description: Measures the volume of crude oil exports originating from the producing region per unit time.

variables.name: Shipping security risk
variables.description: Measures perceived and observed probability and severity of attacks, interdictions, or other disruptions to maritime shipping.

variables.name: Oil price level
variables.description: Measures the prevailing global benchmark crude-oil price level in nominal terms.

variables.name: Oil price volatility
variables.description: Measures short- to medium-term variability and uncertainty in crude-oil prices.

variables.name: Crude inventory stock
variables.description: Measures total commercial and held crude-oil inventory volumes available to the market.

variables.name: Production capacity utilization
variables.description: Measures the percentage utilization of installed crude-oil production capacity in the producing system.

variables.name: Capacity expansion pace
variables.description: Measures the pace at which planned oil production capacity expansions and facility builds are being implemented.

variables.name: Military deployment level
variables.description: Measures intensity, scale, and tempo of deployed military assets operating in or near the maritime and production areas.

variables.name: Reserve release rate
variables.description: Measures the rate and volume at which strategic crude stockpiles are released into markets.

variables.name: Freight and insurance cost
variables.description: Measures shipping freight rates and war-risk insurance premia applied to tanker routes and oil transport.

variables.name: Legal prosecution activity
variables.description: Measures intensity and frequency of legal actions, arrests, and prosecutions related to security and terrorism allegations.

variables.name: Market expectation index
variables.description: Measures collective market sentiment and expectations about future oil supply-demand balance and policy responses.

variables.name: Alternative route usage
variables.description: Measures the share and volume of maritime oil shipments rerouted to non-primary passages (e.g., northern or longer routes).

variables.name: Global oil demand level
variables.description: Measures overall global oil consumption demand across sectors and regions.

catalysts.title: U.S. large military deployments to Mideast
catalysts.description: Continued arrival and sustainment of U.S. carrier strike groups and up to 10,000 troops in the region in response to Iran-related tensions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "U.S. to send third carrier group..."; "U.S. Sending Third Aircraft Carrier, Up to 10,000 More Troops..."

catalysts.title: Continued attacks on tankers in Strait of Hormuz
catalysts.description: Ongoing projectile/boat attacks on commercial tankers in Hormuz, with a risk of repeated incidents disrupting transit and raising security costs.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Three oil tankers hit by projectiles in Hormuz strait"; recurrent shipping-attack coverage.

catalysts.title: Recovery of Middle East crude exports to prewar levels
catalysts.description: Sustained increases in regional exports and shipments (including Iraq moving large volumes through Hormuz) restoring prewar flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Middle Eastern oil exports rise to highest level since Iran war began"; "Iraq says it transported 2 million barrels..."

catalysts.title: Continued strategic reserve releases
catalysts.description: Ongoing or additional coordinated IEA/OECD and national strategic stock releases to ease near-term supply tightness.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "IEA's Birol says oil prices starting to fall after reserve release decision"; "Oil prices fall... on report of potential diesel, crude stock release"

catalysts.title: OPEC+ delays capacity review and expansions
catalysts.description: Postponed OPEC+ capacity review and disrupted expansion plans slow planned capacity additions and defer supply growth.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "EXCLUSIVE: OPEC+ delays oil capacity review after Iran war disrupts expansion plans"

catalysts.title: Increased use of Arctic/longer routes
catalysts.description: Shippers continue diverting some cargoes to Arctic and longer alternative routes, reducing chokepoint transit share but raising voyage costs.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Arctic sea routes boom as Gulf war and global warming divert shipping"

catalysts.title: Legal arrests and prosecutions linked to alleged plots
catalysts.description: Ongoing arrests and court cases in the UK, Portugal and elsewhere related to alleged Iran-linked plots and wartime actions increase legal activity.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Two Iranian nationals charged..."; "Portugal prosecutors probe legality..."; multiple UK arrests and charges.
